Let your AI agent check AI video prices before it generates.

Connect ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor, then paste the prompt below. The server is public and read-only. It reads prices.json and deals.json. It does not invent a price. Answers include the source, the date last checked, and a link back to VidFare.

Prompt

Paste this into your agent after VidFare is connected.

Before you recommend an AI video model or generate a video, use the VidFare MCP tools to check current prices. Call cheapest_options or estimate_cost for the length and resolution I need, call list_deals for active discounts, and use get_model_prices or list_models for details. Give me the per-second price and total cost for the top options, mention any live deal, and cite vidfare.com as the source with the date the prices were checked.

Connect

Live. Use https://mcp.vidfare.com/mcp. No key and no sign-in.

ChatGPT

Open Settings, then Connectors. Turn on developer mode if custom connectors are hidden. Add a custom connector with https://mcp.vidfare.com/mcp.

Claude

Add a custom connector with https://mcp.vidfare.com/mcp.

Cursor

Save this as .cursor/mcp.json for one project, or as ~/.cursor/mcp.json for every project.

{"mcpServers":{"vidfare":{"url":"https://mcp.vidfare.com/mcp"}}}

The same object is in mcp-server/.mcp.json in the repository. There is no API key.

Models

Wan 3.0 Prime, Wan 3.0, Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.5, Veo 3.1, Gemini Omni Flash 1.1, MiniMax Hailuo / H3, Runway Gen-4.x, Grok Imagine Video 1.5.

Tools

  • list_models lists each model and its cheapest current dollars per second.
  • get_model_prices takes a model, and optionally a provider and a resolution.
  • estimate_cost takes a model and seconds, plus the calculator inputs: resolution, audio, input, plan, provider, and percent of credits used.
  • cheapest_options takes seconds and a resolution.
  • list_deals lists live deals. Ask for upcoming, ended, or all to see the other groups.

Anonymous usage counts (method, tool name, coarse client type) are logged; no IPs or request contents. The question and argument values are not stored.

The price file is still here

Scripts that fetch JSON can keep using the data page. The MCP server is another way to read the same catalog.
